opus.problem: Only clue 1 (the name given in place of Hananiah) points to Shadrach alone. Clues 2 through 7 describe what Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego did and suffered together, so each fits Meshach and Abednego just as well, and Abednego is also 8 letters or fewer. A baker who misses clue 1 cannot tell which of the three is meant. The Bible gives almost no facts about Shadrach on his own, so the word does not have 7 different facts that point to it alone. Swap it for a spare.
